description:
About TRA

 At Tax Relief Advocates, we’re committed to serving our clients and community with integrity and empathy. We balance hard work with a vibrant, energetic culture, aiming to make a meaningful impact nationwide. Our mission is to guide people through the tax resolution process with trust, education, and care.

 About the Role

 As an AI Full‑Stack Developer at TRA, you'll bring our AI-powered tools to life through intuitive UIs and practical dashboards. You’ll be the bridge between cutting-edge AI capabilities and user experiences - building chatbots, analytics interfaces, and secure web applications that our clients and team can rely on. 

 Responsibilities

 
 Design and architect comprehensive full-stack solutions that integrate AI/ML models, conversational interfaces, backend systems, and user-facing applications

 Design, deploy, and maintain large-scale AI systems with high availability, performance, and reliability in production environments

 Develop and integrate website chatbot front-ends connected to our AI systems

 Design dashboards to monitor AI outputs and training analytics, enhancing visibility and insight

 Ensure web applications are secure, user-friendly, and performant

 Collaborate closely with AI/ML and backend teams to deliver full-stack, end-to-end solutions

 
 Qualifications

 
 3+ years of full-stack development experience with proven expertise in solutions architecture

 Advanced proficiency in modern front-end frameworks (React, Next.js) and backend technologies (Node.js, Python)

 Strong experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs and microservices architectures

 Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (Azure or GCP) including deployment, scaling, and infrastructure as code

 Demonstrated ability to integrate AI/ML models into production applications

 Proven track record building secure, scalable, client-facing web applications

 Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns and workflow automation

 
 Nice to Have

 
 Experience with OpenTelemetry for distributed tracing, metrics, and observability across AI and microservices pipelines

 Familiarity with LangSmith or Langfuse for LLM application monitoring, evaluation, and debugging

 
 Why Join Us?

 At TRA, you’ll be part of a high-impact, forward-thinking team revolutionizing tax resolution through innovative AI and automation. You'll take on exciting challenges, collaborate with top talent, and play a central role in delivering client-first solutions at scale.

 We’re not just building smarter systems—we’re building a better experience for every person who turns to us for help. 

  

 Location: Irvine, CA - onsite

 Compensation: Up to $120,000 - $140,000 depending on experience 

 Position Type: Full-time, permanent



 Application Process 

 Qualified applicants will be invited to complete a brief AI-facilitated interview designed to help us learn more about your experience and qualifications.  After the AI interview, a member of our recruiting team will personally review your responses and follow up with next steps if you're selected to move forward.  This AI tool is used solely to support our recruiters in the initial screening process -- all final hiring decisions are made by our talent acquisition team.

 
 We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity and encourage all qualified individuals to apply.
